description: Search the CSO catalog of ~12,600 Irish statistics tables. Returns matching tables with their matrix code (e.g. "CPM01"), label, dimensions, and last-updated date. The full catalog is large, so always pass a keyword query to narrow it.

query.description: Keyword(s) matched against table label and matrix code, e.g. "consumer price", "population", "QLF". Case-insensitive.

name: list_datasets
title: List Datasets
